### CVE-2001-1246
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-06-25 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20985: PHP 4.x - SafeMode Arbitrary File Execution (local/php, 2001-06-30, verified=1)

PHP 4.0.5 through 4.1.0 in safe mode does not properly cleanse the 5th parameter to the mail() function, which allows local users and possibly remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via shell metacharacters.

### CVE-2001-1524
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-07-14 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21166: PHP-Nuke 1.0/2.5/3.0/4.x/5.x/6.x/7.x - 'modules.php' Multiple Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerabilities (webapps/php, 2001-12-03, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 21165: PHP-Nuke 1.0/2.5/3.0/4.x/5.x/6.x/7.x - 'user.php?uname' Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/php, 2001-12-03, verified=1)

Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in PHP-Nuke 5.3.1 and earlier allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the (1) uname parameter in user.php, (2) ttitle, letter and file parameters in modules.php, (3) subject, story and storyext parameters in submit.php, (4) upload parameter in admin.php and (5) fname parameter in friend.php.
